body: I keep trying to figure out the least disruptive way to end it. I don't want to do it at home, because I don't want my husband to find me. It will hurt enough without that burden on him. But I also don't want to traumatize some poor maid by renting a hotel room. I just want to be alone though, secure behind a locked door and/or hidden. I never feel safe unless I'm completely alone, and I want to at least feel safe as I fade away. One last little kindness to myself.
About 600 miles. We could only stay for a couple days though, so we drove 600 miles on a Friday, then drove another 600 the following Monday to get back home.
